deals.sourceText: Walmart's Black Friday deal drops this ASUS TUF Gaming A16 laptop to $1,299. That's $500 off its regular price, and around $200 less than you'd pay for a similarly-specced laptop elsewhere. It pairs an RTX 5060 graphics chip with a 165Hz display and 16GB of DDR5 RAM. Shipping is free on this order, too. Deal ends November 15. deals.title: MSI Cyborg 13th-Gen i5 15.6" Laptop w/ NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 for $799 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: This MSI Cyborg gaming laptop has dropped to $799 at Walmart as part of its Black Friday Sale. That's $100 under our mention from August and the best deal we've seen for this build. It costs $184 more right now at Amazon. The laptop has a 144Hz display, which smooths out motion in fast-paced games. The laptop pairs an RTX 5050 graphics chip with 16GB of DDR5 memory and a 512GB SSD. Shipping is free on this order, too. The deal ends on November 15. deals.sourceText: This i5-equipped Dell laptop is one of Walmart's Black Friday deals, dropping to just $429. That's $21 cheaper than what we saw a month ago and $121 cheaper than Amazon's price. It pairs a 15.6" Full HD touchscreen with 8GB of RAM and a 512GB solid state drive. Shipping is free on this order, too. It ends on November 15. deals.title: EcoFlow Delta 3 Max 2048Wh Portable Power Station for $849 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: As one of Best Buy's daily deals, this EcoFlow Delta 3 Max power station drops to $849. That's $30 less than you'd pay elsewhere today. It can run appliances rated up to 3,400W in X-Boost mode and recharges to 80% in about 68 minutes from a wall outlet. The battery is rated for 3,000 charge cycles and the unit carries a 5-year warranty. My Best Buy members get free shipping on all orders (it's free to join). This deal ends today. deals.title: JBL 8" Powered Portable Bluetooth Speaker Kit w/ Cover, Stand, & Cable for $350 + shipping varies
deals.sourceText: B&H Photo's JBL IRX108BT speaker kit is $196 off at $350 during its Holiday Savings. The bundle adds a water-resistant slip cover, a steel tripod stand that adjusts from 3 to 6.5', and a 20' XLR cable to the powered 8" speaker. The speaker also offers Bluetooth streaming and two mic/line inputs for use as a small PA system. Buy Now at B&H Photo Video Features 8" woofer with 1300W amplifier Frequency response of 54Hz to 20kHz with 124dB max volume Bluetooth 5.0 streaming, plus 2 mic/line inputs & XLR output 4 EQ presets, bass boost, & built-in feedback suppression Includes water-resistant cover, tripod stand (3 to 6.5' adjustable), & 20' XLR cable
